comparison.objective: Replace two opposed-polarity cells beneath a spring-return service cover; candidate finishes four threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Sustained cover support, opposed-contact cell extraction/insertion, and polarity orientation versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammering, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Both correct cells installed, cover closed, mechanism stable, and arms clear versus four fractured and recovered tangs without coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Both involve bimanual servicing, but the constrained exchange and spring-cover mechanism test a different ability.
